subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Identifies rhyming words in well-known rhymes and songs

show.line: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall. Humpty Dumpty had a great fall. Wall, fall! They rhyme.

rounds.story: Twinkle, twinkle, little star, how I wonder what you are. Which word rhymes with star?

rounds.prompt: Hickory dickory dock. The mouse ran up the? It rhymes with dock.
Jack and Jill went up the hill. Which one rhymes with hill?
Does it rhyme with cat, or with wall? Put each one in its group.

hints: Listen to the end of the word. Wall, ball. Same ending!
Say both words. Do they sound the same at the end?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a rhyme for cat.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cat and dog do not rhyme. Cat, hat!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Cat, hat. Same ending!

parent_line: Can find the rhyming words in songs and rhymes.
